description: This file defines a test class 'I18NServiceTest' for testing the 'I18NService' component in the OrangeHRM project. It contains various test methods that verify translation fetching, cache handling, and language switching functionalities related to internationalization (i18n).

classes.name: I18NServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of the I18NService component, including translation retrieval, caching, and language switching.

methods.name: testGetI18NDao
methods.description: Verifies that the getI18NDao() method returns an instance of I18NDao.

methods.name: testGetTranslator
methods.description: Tests that the getTranslator() method returns a Translator instance with the expected locale and behaviors.

methods.name: testGetTranslationCollection
methods.description: Checks the correct creation and contents of the TranslationCollection for a given language code.

methods.name: testGenerateCacheKeyPrefixForLang
methods.description: Validates the generation of cache key prefix based on language code.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationCacheKey
methods.description: Checks the correct formation of translation cache key.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationKeyTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Verifies cache key generation for translation key target array.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationSourceTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Verifies cache key generation for translation source-target array.

methods.name: testGenerateETagCacheKey
methods.description: Checks generation of ETag cache key.

methods.name: testGetETagByLangCode
methods.description: Verifies the method returns consistent ETAG values for a language code using cache.

methods.name: testGetETagByLangCodeWithMultipleLanguages
methods.description: Tests ETAG retrieval when switching between multiple language codes.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesAsJsonString
methods.description: Checks the JSON string output of translation messages for a given language.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArray
methods.description: Verifies correctness of key-target translation messages array.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArrayWithInCaseNotCreatedCache
methods.description: Tests fallback and cache behavior when translation cache is missing.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArray
methods.description: Verifies the source-target translation message array.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArrayWithInCaseNotCreatedCache
methods.description: Tests fallback and cache behavior for source-target messages.

methods.name: testTrans
methods.description: Verifies translation function with keys and parameters, including language fallback.

methods.name: testTransWithMultipleLanguages
methods.description: Ensures translation works correctly across multiple languages and language switching.

methods.name: testTransBySource
methods.description: Tests translation retrieval directly by source string.

methods.name: getMockI18NDao
methods.description: Creates a mock I18NDao returning specified translation data, used for testing.
